cues.en: So that was a lot of work here in this module.
We worked a lot on the data.
We added our meetup store with our custom store, with all these useful custom methods that allow us
to manipulate the store with all these core Crud functionalities.
We're subscribing to the store in different places.
We're passing data around, we're interacting with the store from different places, and I therefore
hope that this module really gave you an idea of how you work with data in svelte apps, how you can
manage it globally with a store, how you can tap into it from different places, and how you can build
a nice app with nice components, reusable components with good component communication and with a store
to glue all your data together.
